name: Inakadate (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Inakadate village emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing two outlined characters.
history: Municipal flag of Inakadate, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 August 1959.

features.role: Inakadate village emblem — a broken ring enclosing two outlined characters
